keyed.HH.Kitchen.Stale: Stale: no Well fed, no mood bonus.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Stat.WellDesc: How long hunger falls slower after eating this dish. Scales with learning level and quality.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Stat.MoodDesc: Mood bonus from a proper dish, by learning level and quality (stale dishes give none).
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Title: Colony cookbook
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.UnknownHint: Not learned yet. Research {0}, or find a cookbook.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Dark: Hidden: the dark menu is off.
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.shelfLife.Desc: How long plates stay fresh, relative to the 3 to 24 hours of each dish. Stale plates are still edible but give no Well fed and no mood bonus.
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.wellFedStrength.Desc: How much slower hunger falls after a proper dish (100 % = 40 % slower).
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.wellFedDuration.Desc: How long the Well fed state lasts, relative to 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 hours by learning level (and by quality).
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.menuPrice.Desc: Prices a restaurant asks for dishes, relative to the standard menu (dish level, quality and form).
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.poisonRule: No food poisoning from a good kitchen
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.poisonRule.Desc: Plates cooked by a cook with Cooking 4 or more in a clean kitchen (cleanliness -0.2 or better) can never poison. Off: vanilla rolls apply.
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.variants.Desc: Offer each dish in a Fine form (more and better ingredients, a better chance for good quality) and a Signature form (research needed).
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.allKnown.Desc: Skip learning: every dish of the menu can be cooked as soon as its devices stand.
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.cookSounds.Desc: Every kind of cooking (chopping, simmering, grilling, baking, frying, steaming, kneading, smoking, chilling) has its own sound and little effect, finished fine dishes ring a cue and good plates get a happy reaction. Off: the vanilla pan-frying sound for everything.
keyed.HH.Setting.kitchen.darkMenu.Desc: Allow the long pork dishes. Always needs content intensity Dark or Grim; with that, an ideoligion that approves of cannibalism unlocks them even when this is off.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.AllKnown: The colony already knows every dish in this book.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Learned: {0} studies the book. The colony can now cook: {1}.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.TestKitchen.Success: {0} worked out how to cook {1}. The colony will remember.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.TestKitchen.Failure: {0} tried to cook {1} and made a terrible plate of it. Maybe next time.
keyed.HH.Kitchen.NoNeighbours: No other kitchen device in reach.

defs.ThingDef/HH_Cookbook.label: recipe book
defs.ThingDef/HH_Cookbook.description: A greasy, dog-eared book of recipes, annotated by someone who clearly cooked under fire. Reading it teaches the colony the dishes it contains.
defs.RecipeDef/HH_TestKitchen.label: experiment with a new dish
defs.RecipeDef/HH_TestKitchen.description: Throw raw food at the counter and see what comes out. Sometimes the colony works out a new dish (the better the cook, the likelier); otherwise the experiment ends as a terrible plate of that dish.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CampfireS: Everything went into the pot, including the argument about what everything meant. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PotatoSou: Tastes like home, if home had a dirt floor and low expectations.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SpitRoast: Turned by hand for an hour by whoever lost the coin toss.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HashAndEg: A breakfast that says the day will not get better, but will get fried.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CornPorri: Thick enough to patch a wall in an emergency.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BerryComp: The only thing on the Rim that is both sweet and cheap.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PlainStea: Rice. It is rice. Please stop looking at the menu for more.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Congee.de: Rice porridge for people who have had a very long week and a very long raid.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggDropSo: Eggs swirled into hot broth, because the broth needed a hobby.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RoastCorn: Eaten standing up, in the rain, while someone shoots at the stall.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RoastPota: Golden, crunchy and the closest thing to joy in sector seven.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MilkRiceP: Comfort food for colonists whose comfort has been recalled.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Scrambled: Eggs, but rearranged until they stopped complaining.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BugSkewer: Crunchy on the outside and not a lot of questions on the inside.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RawFishSl: Sliced by someone who watched a video about it once.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PanFriedF: If it swam yesterday, it fries today.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_AgavePanc: Stacked high to hide the fact that there is only one egg.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FruitBowl: Healthy, fresh and gone in four seconds when the children arrive.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MushroomP: Chilled mushrooms, because the fridge was already running.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CrimsonSm: Berries, milk and a secret pink.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedJer: Lasts forever, which is also how long it takes to chew.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Bratwurst: Sausage in a bun, beer in a mug, regret in the morning.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_InsectTac: Three tacos, zero questions, and a very good sauce.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishAndCh: Fried twice for luck and once for spite.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloRa: Slurp loudly. In a fight for the last bowl, slurp even louder. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggFriedR: Yesterday's rice, today's problem, tomorrow's lunch.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PadThrumb: A sweet-sour tangle of noodles and crunch, wok-fired until it behaves. The crunch comes from insect meat.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ChiliConC: Hot enough to cauterize. Do not use as medicine. Do use as medicine.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_JollofRic: The recipe is a fight between three colonies, all of whom are right.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_UgaliWith: Corn dough you eat with your hands, so nothing is lost when you flee.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BakedEggs: Eggs that went through a lot and came out saucy.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HashBrown: A potato pancake that has seen things in the drive-through.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CornFritt: Fried, golden and gone before anyone remembers to share.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PotatoGra: Cream, potatoes, patience. Nothing else works that well on the Rim.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MushroomR: Stir it for twenty minutes or lose a friend. Your choice.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SteamedBu: Soft as a pillow, filled with something that definitely was meat.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocolate: The reason raids get postponed by exactly one dessert.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Ceviche.d: Fish cooked by sourness alone, which is how most colonies work too.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloGo: Red, thick, and officially the unofficial national argument. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggFlan.d: Wobbles like a colonist at the end of a long shift.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BeerBatte: Crunch, foam, and not a word to the neighbours.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CreamyNoo: A casserole that holds the colony together better than the leaders do.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Fermented: Fermented, fierce and hard to forgive. Good for the guts, they say.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RimMein.d: Fried noodles, wok-tossed, and exactly as healthy as it looks.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColdPotat: The potluck dish nobody planned and everybody finishes.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CreamyMus: Noodles in cream, like the pasta you remember, after a few rounds of rumours.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongPorkS: The recipe is a secret. The ingredient is not.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedLon: Lasts all winter. So does the guilt.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CongeeOfT: A warm porridge for a cold, cold conscience.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BloodBrot: A dark, rich broth for the thirsty and the polite.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HemogenBl: Fried until it stops looking at you.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloBo: Braised in beer, because the wine ran out on the second day. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColonyPae: Whatever was in the pantry, arranged with great dignity.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_NigiriPla: Rice and fish, shaped by someone who should be on the front line instead.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ThrumboPh: A clear broth with a very long to-do list behind it. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Biryani.d: Layers of rice, meat and diplomacy, sealed with a lid.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Dromedary: Slow-cooked in a clay cone, like most people wish to be. Traditionally made from dromedary.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MushroomM: Seven layers deep, and every layer has an opinion.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Lacquered: Glazed until it shines brighter than the colony's bank account. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TomYumSou: Sour, spicy and will clear your sinuses and your debts.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Laksa.des: A coconut-less curry soup that does not apologize.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Tamales.d: Wrapped in leaves, like a gift nobody asked for.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DimSumBas: Tiny portions for tiny budgets with huge pretensions.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocolate: Many layers, none of them honest.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GravyFrie: Fries, gravy and a quiet moment of national pride.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedBri: Smoked for twelve hours by a man who will not talk about it.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Churros.d: Fried dough with a chocolate dip and no remorse.
Mix everything in one bowl, exactly like the colony itself.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mongolian: Wok-fried, sweet, sticky and a bit too loud. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColdNoodl: Served so cold the noodles file complaints.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloCa: Sliced thin enough to read the menu through it. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ThrumboTa: Raw, fierce and brave. Sign the waiver first. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DanDanNoo: Spicy noodles that warn you in advance and still win.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GrilledLo: Smoky, sweet, and extremely hard to explain at a dinner party.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongPorkD: Hand-folded, with a filling nobody asks about twice.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Strangers: Sunday dinner, with a guest who did not come willingly.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Cannibals: Spicy enough to hide the taste, and the thought.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HemogenRi: Creamy, red and a touch too intense.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RedSteakV: Practically bleating. Done exactly how a sanguophage ordered it.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TwistedMe: The bun twitches only slightly. Please don't tell the filling.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloWe: Wrapped in pastry, a tiny insulation for a very grand ego. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Boomalope: Slow-cooked in its own fat. Do not stand next to the pot. Traditionally made from boomalope, carefully.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishTherm: Creamy, gratinated and absurdly proud of itself.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Rendang.d: Simmered until the sauce gives up and joins the meat.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MoleNegro: Dark, bitter and sweet: like the best advice.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocolate: Rises like a bad rumour, falls just as fast.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CremeBrul: The crust cracks under a spoon, as under pressure.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_AgaveBakl: So sweet you will need a medic and a poet.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MuffaloSt: Creamy, rich and gone by the third spoon. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_OmakaseNi: The chef decides what you eat. You decide to be impressed.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TeppanFea: A flaming griddle, a flipping spatula and a fire extinguisher nearby.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ClayOvenM: Marinated overnight, blasted in a clay oven and served with arrogance. Traditionally made from muffalo.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Churrasco: Meat on swords, delivered until you surrender.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HuntersBi: A stew that gets better every day and worse every smell.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LambKofta: Spiced, shaped and served over rice like a very tasty lecture. Traditionally made from lamb.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SevenCour: Starter, starter, starter, main, dessert, dessert and a toast.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TartareOf: Served raw, because cooking is for those with something to hide.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HemogenCa: Thin, red and served with a stare.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TwistedHo: It bubbles on its own. Nobody turned on the stove.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CheeseFon: A pot of molten cheese and the rule that whoever drops the bread, pays.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PumpkinAn: Orange, cheesy and decorated with a thin layer of danger.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FlourDump: Dumplings the size of fists, for people who prefer a soup with a punch.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CheeseOme: The omelette that apologizes for nothing and folds for nobody.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FruitGlaz: Sticky, sweet and carried to the table with oven gloves and prayers.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SushiRoll: Rolled tight, dipped lightly and eaten before anyone gets ideas.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_WasabiGla: It clears the nose, the throat and every previous opinion.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TempuraSu: Sushi that took a wrong turn into the fryer and liked it.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HeartyWin: Cooked for days over a wood-fired pot. Eat it before the pot talks back.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongNight: Simmered through the night by someone who had no better plans.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_StewOfQue: The stew removes any regret about the insects. The regret about the stew remains.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SugarCook: Decorated by a colonist whose hands shake from combat, and it shows.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FancyCupc: A tiny cake with a big sprinkle problem.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GlazedDon: A ring of dough around a hole in the budget.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HauteCuis: Eight tiny plates, one giant bill.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GlazedFru: A tart with more fruit than structure, which is the correct ratio.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PickledVe: Pickled so hard that it has outlived the colony's first leader.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HerbRoast: Potatoes that have been to a garden party and brought back a plant.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BerryAndN: Crunchy, healthy and extremely not what the raiders asked for.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TeaSmoked: Smoked with tea, because why shouldn't the meat relax too.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_StrawFlou: Flat, honest, and a little bit sandy. Like the desert it came from.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CactusFru: Sweet and spiny, just like your best friend.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Greenfrui: A stew so green that the muffalo took offence.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Strawflou: Dumplings from the wasteland, filled with something that may have been meat.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DesertBre: Liquid and solid breakfast, in the right order.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GrilledWh: A whole fish, a little salt, and no apology to the fish.
Anything that swims ends up here sooner or later.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedFis: Fillet of the day, smoked until it forgot the river.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SashimiPl: Raw fish, thinly sliced, and a tiny moral dilemma.
defs.Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishTacos: Fish in a tortilla, delivered by a colonist who ran the whole way.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Soup.label: soup bowl
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Soup.description: A bowl of something hot and wet. Eaten with a spoon, a prayer, or both.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Stew.label: stew pot
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Stew.description: A heavy bowl of slow-cooked stew, steaming with the promise of a second helping.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Grill.label: grill platter
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Grill.description: Meat that has had a conversation with an open flame and lost.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Noodles.label: noodle bowl
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Noodles.description: A tangle of noodles in a bowl. Slurping is not optional.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Rice.label: rice dish
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Rice.description: A mound of rice with opinions, served on a plate with a fork nobody asked for.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Bake.label: baked dish
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Bake.description: Something that went into the oven as ingredients and came out as a decision.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Fry.label: fried plate
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Fry.description: Golden, crunchy and wildly unhealthy. Exactly what the colony ordered.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Salad.label: salad plate
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Salad.description: A cold plate with a lot of leaves, very little remorse, and a short shelf life.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Raw.label: raw plate
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Raw.description: Thinly sliced, expensively arranged and absolutely not cooked.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Breakfast.label: breakfast plate
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Breakfast.description: A plate that says the day has started, whether you like it or not.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Dessert.label: dessert dish
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_Dessert.description: A small, sweet reward for surviving another day on the Rim.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_StreetFood.label: street food tray
defs.ThingDef/HH_Plate_StreetFood.description: Hot, handheld and best eaten standing up, quickly, with one eye on the exits.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Cooking_L1.label: home cooking
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Cooking_L1.descrip: Stews, porridge, fried eggs and everything else a hungry colony cooks without a recipe book. Known from the start.
defs.HediffDef/HH_WellFed.label: well fed
defs.HediffDef/HH_WellFed.description: A proper dish keeps the stomach quiet for longer: hunger falls slower while this lasts.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_PrepCounter.label: prep counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_PrepCounter.descript: A scarred counter with a cutting board, a good knife and a drainage groove nobody asked about. Chop, slice and carve here; other devices of a dish must stand close by.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_StockPot.label: stock pot
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_StockPot.description: A big iron pot over a wood fire. Simmers, boils and stews anything that was ever alive. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Grill.label: grill
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Grill.description: A grate over glowing coals. Meat goes on raw, comes off with opinions. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Oven.label: oven
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Oven.description: A stone and iron oven for roasting and baking. Takes a long time to heat and a short time to ruin dinner. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_WokStation.label: wok station
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_WokStation.descripti: A round-bottomed pan over a roaring flame. Everything is stir-fried here, including the cook's eyebrows. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_DeepFryer.label: deep fryer
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_DeepFryer.descriptio: A vat of boiling oil with a basket and a strong sense of its own danger. Electric. Catches fire more readily than anything else in the kitchen.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Smoker.label: smoker
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Smoker.description: A tall wooden cabinet that turns meat into something that lasts. Needs wood chips, patience and no neighbours. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Steamer.label: steamer
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_Steamer.description: Stacked bamboo baskets over a pot of boiling water. Soft, gentle and almost impossible to burn. Burns wood while it works.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_DoughBench.label: dough bench
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_DoughBench.descripti: A heavy bench with a flour-dusted top. Rice and corn are pounded into dough here, which is cheaper than therapy.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_ColdStation.label: cold station
defs.ThingDef/HH_Station_ColdStation.descript: A chilled counter that keeps salads crisp and desserts firm. Electric.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.label: ate a proper dish

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.0.descripti: I ate a awful dish of home cooking.

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.1.descripti: I ate a poor dish of home cooking.

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.2.descripti: I ate a normal dish of home cooking.

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.3.descripti: I ate a good dish of home cooking.

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.4.descripti: I ate a excellent dish of home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.5.label: masterwork home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.5.descripti: I ate a masterwork dish of home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.6.label: legendary home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.6.descripti: I ate a legendary dish of home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.7.label: awful good home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.7.descripti: I ate a awful dish of good home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.8.label: poor good home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.8.descripti: I ate a poor dish of good home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.9.label: normal good home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.9.descripti: I ate a normal dish of good home cooking.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.10.label: good good home cooking
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AteDish.stages.10.descript: I ate a good dish of good home cooking.
